description: This file defines a diff tool for a plugin system, including schema validation, input normalization, rendering logic, and artifact management for diff visualization and export.

classes.name: PluginToolInputError
classes.description: Custom error class for input validation errors in the diff tool.

methods.name: createDiffsTool
methods.description: Factory function that creates a diff tool plugin with specified parameters, handling diff rendering, artifact creation, and URL generation.

methods.name: normalizeFileQuality
methods.description: Normalizes the file quality preset input to ensure it is within allowed presets.

methods.name: normalizeOutputFormat
methods.description: Normalizes the output format input to ensure it is within allowed formats.

methods.name: isArtifactOnlyMode
methods.description: Checks if the mode is 'image' or 'file', indicating artifact-only rendering.

methods.name: resolveRenderTarget
methods.description: Determines the render target based on the mode ('viewer', 'image', or 'both').

methods.name: requireRenderedHtml
methods.description: Ensures that the HTML render output exists for the specified target.

methods.name: buildArtifactDetails
methods.description: Constructs detailed metadata for the diff artifact, including file paths and sizes.

methods.name: buildFileArtifactMessage
methods.description: Creates a message string with diff file information and optional viewer URL.

methods.name: renderDiffArtifactFile
methods.description: Generates a diff artifact file by rendering HTML to an image or PDF, and returns file info.

methods.name: buildArtifactContext
methods.description: Builds context information for artifacts from plugin context.

methods.name: normalizeContextString
methods.description: Trims and normalizes context string values.

methods.name: normalizeDiffInput
methods.description: Normalizes and validates diff input parameters, ensuring correct patch or before/after content.

methods.name: assertMaxBytes
methods.description: Checks if a string exceeds maximum byte size, throws error if so.

methods.name: normalizeBaseUrl
methods.description: Normalizes and validates the base URL for viewer links.

methods.name: normalizeMode
methods.description: Normalizes mode input, falling back to default if invalid.

methods.name: normalizeTheme
methods.description: Normalizes theme input, falling back to default if invalid.

methods.name: normalizeLayout
methods.description: Normalizes layout input, falling back to default if invalid.

methods.name: normalizeTtlMs
methods.description: Converts TTL seconds to milliseconds, ensuring finite number.
